sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访多位在商业、政治和文化领域极具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mamdani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·马姆达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews at nytimes.com and in the Times app on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 以及《纽约时报》App 上直播部分采访。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: Public assassinations, weapons of mass destruction in international airports, open threats of nuclear war.
sentences.zh: 公开暗杀、国际机场的大规模杀伤性武器、对核战争的公开威胁。

sentences.en: Is the strategy of North Korea so crazy that it just might work?
sentences.zh: 朝鲜的战略是不是疯狂到居然可能奏效？

sentences.en: And after months of polarizing talk about illegal immigration and what to do about it,
sentences.zh: 在经历了数月关于非法移民及其应对措施的两极化讨论之后，

sentences.en: President Trump puts forward a plan for legal immigration and credits Canada with the idea.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统提出了一项合法移民计划，并称这个创意来自加拿大。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是 3 月 2 日，星期四。

sentences.en: Entering Kuala Lumpur Airport in the gray suit, this CCTV appears to show Kim Jong-nam.
sentences.zh: 这段闭路电视画面显示，身穿灰色西装的金正男进入了吉隆坡机场。

sentences.en: He continues into the busy departures hall.
sentences.zh: 他继续走向人头攒动的出发大厅。

sentences.en: If you watch extremely closely, a figure wearing a white top seems to approach him from behind and grab him.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细观看，一个身穿白色上衣的身影似乎从身后接近了他并抓住了他。

sentences.en: The person in white throws their arms over the victim's head and applies pressure before walking away.
sentences.zh: 穿白衣服的人将双手搭在受害者的头上并施加压力，然后走开了。

sentences.en: Kim Jong-un's estranged half-brother, Kim Jong-nam, allegedly murdered.
sentences.zh: 金正恩同父异母的哥哥金正男据称被谋杀。

sentences.en: Kim Jong-nam was the portly playboy and half-brother of current North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 金正男是现任朝鲜领导人金正恩大腹便便、爱过花花公子生活的同父异母哥哥。

sentences.en: Now to a breaking headline overseas, authorities making new arrests in the assassination of the North Korean leader's half-brother.
sentences.zh: 接下来是一条海外突发新闻，有关部门对朝鲜领导人同父异母哥哥的暗杀事件进行了新一轮逮捕。

sentences.en: Targeted by female assassins, reportedly the victim of a spy movie-style hit.
sentences.zh: 成为女刺客的目标，据报道是一起间谍电影风格的暗杀。

sentences.en: One of the women claimed she was tricked into attacking Kim, believing that she was taking part in some kind of television prank.
sentences.zh: 其中一名女子声称自己被骗去袭击金正男，以为自己是在参加某种电视恶作剧。

sentences.en: He wasn't considered much of a threat to his younger brother, except, experts say, maybe in Kim Jong-un's own mind.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他对他的弟弟构不成多大威胁，但专家表示，也许在金正恩自己的心里并非如此。

sentences.en: A brazen assassination that many people here believe could only have been ordered by North Korea's leader.
sentences.zh: 这是一起明目张胆的暗杀，这里的许多人认为，这只能是由朝鲜领导人下令实施的。

sentences.en: By now you know the story, and it's almost an unbelievable one.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，你们都知道这个故事了，而且几乎令人难以置信。

sentences.en: According to the interpreters, Max Fisher and Amanda Taub, that's exactly how North Korea wants you to see it.
sentences.zh: 据口译员马克斯·费舍尔和阿曼达·陶布所说，这正是朝鲜希望你看到的模样。

sentences.en: Let's take the assassination apart a little bit.
sentences.zh: 让我们来剖析一下这次暗杀。

sentences.en: In what ways was this carried out for maximum impact, step by step?
sentences.zh: 这起暗杀在哪些方面是为了达到最大冲击力而一步步实施的？

sentences.en: So Kim Jong-nam was in the departures lounge in the airport in Kuala Lumpur.
sentences.zh: 所以金正男当时在吉隆坡机场的离境大厅里。

sentences.en: He was getting on a flight to Macau.
sentences.zh: 他正准备搭乘飞往澳门的航班。

sentences.en: And two women came up to him, one after another.
sentences.zh: 然后两名女子先后向他走来。

sentences.en: And from the CCTV footage, it looks like they smeared something on his face.
sentences.zh: 从监控录像来看，她们似乎把某种东西抹在了他的脸上。

sentences.en: They killed him using VX, which is classified as a weapon of mass destruction by the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 她们使用 VX 杀害了他，这被联合国归类为大规模杀伤性武器。

sentences.en: A super advanced chemical weapon to kill him in the middle of this airport, which is like, not what VX is for?
sentences.zh: 用一种超级先进的化学武器在这个机场的正中央杀死他，这就像，VX 是用来干这个的吗？

sentences.en: What is VX for?
sentences.zh: VX 是用来干什么的？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know that it's actually been used in a large-scale way in a war, but it is meant to be like the 21st century version of what mustard gas was in World War I.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不知道它是否真的在战争中被大规模使用过，但它本意应该是第一次世界大战中芥末毒气在 21 番纪的升级版。

sentences.en: It's one of the deadliest chemical agents ever created.
sentences.zh: 它是人类创造的最致命的化学毒剂之一。

sentences.en: Experts say VX is one of the most potent chemical weapons.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，VX 是效力最强的化学武器之一。

sentences.en: It can kill almost instantly.
sentences.zh: 它几乎可以瞬间致人死亡。

sentences.en: Paralysis, respiratory failure, and death can occur within minutes.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内就会发生瘫痪、呼吸衰竭和死亡。

sentences.en: Like a weapon of war that you would use to cause mass destruction and chaos on the order of the size of cities.
sentences.zh: 就像一种战争武器，你会用它来造成城市规模的大规模破坏和混乱。

sentences.en: But they deployed it to kill exactly one person, which is bananas.
sentences.zh: 但他们居然用它来暗杀区区一个人，这简直荒唐透顶。

sentences.en: And so what they believe happened in this attack is that it wasn't pre-mixed, essentially, VX, that it was two different components, which each on their own were not deadly,
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为这次袭击发生的情况是，VX 本身并不是预先混合好的，而是由两种不同的成分组成的，这两种成分各自本身并不致命，

sentences.en: were maybe even harmless, but that when they were mixed together, which in this case happened on the victim's face when two different people smeared it on him,
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是无害的，但是当它们混合在一起时——在本案中是当两个人把这两种不同的成分分别抹在受害者脸上时，

sentences.en: they mixed together and turned into potent VX and killed him.
sentences.zh: 它们混合在了一起，变成了强效的 VX 并将他杀害。

sentences.en: What does this assassination appear to be on the surface?
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，这场暗杀是一场怎样的行动？

sentences.en: So I think on the surface, this really plays into the idea that a lot of people have of North Korea as this really kind of crazy, irrational, unhinged regime almoSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得从表面来看，这非常符合许多人对朝鲜的印象，即这是一个非常疯狂、不理性、甚至有点精神错乱的政权。

sentences.en: And this is something that comes up a lot in pop culture, where the North Korean leaders are portrayed as these kind of cartoon evil figures who are, you know,
sentences.zh: 这在流行文化中经常出现，朝鲜领导人被描绘成那种卡通式的邪恶反派，你知道的，

sentences.en: just sort of larger than life and nuts.
sentences.zh: 有点夸张而且是个疯子。

sentences.en: If a billion people across the earth and in my own country must be burned to prove it, then my worthiness as a king will be demonstrated.
sentences.zh: 如果地球上和我国的十亿人必须被烧死来证明这一点，那么我作为国王的价值就得到了证明。

sentences.en: But that, I think, is a pretty misleading perception.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这是一种非常具有误导性的看法。

sentences.en: The two things that people will tell you are that this country's leadership are irrational, wacky, cannot-be-trusted, totally nuts,
sentences.zh: 人们会告诉你的两点是，这个国家的领导层是不理性的、古怪的、不可信的、彻头彻尾的疯子，

sentences.en: and that they're super weak and they have this shambles, barely-functional weapons program.
sentences.zh: 而且他们极其软弱，拥有一个一团糟、几乎无法运转的武器计划。

sentences.en: And it's actually exactly backwards.
sentences.zh: 但事实恰恰相反。

sentences.en: This leadership is super rational, which is how they've managed to stay alive, despite being in this terrible geopolitical position and much weaker than their all-enemies.
sentences.zh: 这个领导层极其理性，这就是他们如何在身处如此糟糕的地缘政治地位、且比所有敌人弱得多时，依然设法生存下来的原因。

sentences.en: And their weapons programs are not sophisticated in the level of the United States or Russia, but for a country that small, super sophisticated, super threatening.
sentences.zh: 他们的武器计划虽不像美国或俄罗斯那样高度先进，但对于一个那么小的国家来说，已经超级先进、超级具有威胁性了。

sentences.en: And the really key thing, they are willing to use it abroad, internationally, in some place as sensitive as an international airport, which is designed to freak us out and,
sentences.zh: 最关键的是，他们愿意在海外、在国际上使用它，甚至在国际机场这样敏感的地方使用，这旨在吓唬我们，而且坦率地说，

sentences.en: frankly, I think should.
sentences.zh: 我认为它确实应该如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, this was basically a really gruesome, deadly military press release.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这基本上是一份极其骇人、致命的军事新闻稿。

sentences.en: This was a message to the world saying, we can do this, we will do this, and everyone paid attention.
sentences.zh: 这是向世界发出的一个信息，表明：我们能做到，我们也会这样做，而所有人都注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: This press release, Amanda, that you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 你提到的这份新闻稿，阿曼达。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's a great coinage.
sentences.zh: 这个词造得太妙了。

sentences.en: Who is it directed to?
sentences.zh: 它是针对谁的？

sentences.en: Is it directed to the citizens of North Korea?
sentences.zh: 它是针对朝鲜公民的吗？

sentences.en: Is it directed to the elected leaders in foreign countries?
sentences.zh: 它是针对外国民选领导人的吗？

sentences.en: This is a way of basically saying that any other country that would be thinking of trying to mess with the North Korean regime basically should think twice about doing so.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是在向其他任何考虑试图招惹朝鲜政权的國家发出警告，让他们在这样做之前三思而后行。

sentences.en: I mean, schoolyard metaphors are totally overused in international relations, and I hate when people do it, so I'm going to go ahead and do it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，校园隐喻在国际关系中已经被用烂了，我很讨厌别人这么做，所以我现在就要这么做。

sentences.en: If you imagine, like, North Korea is the, like, tiniest, scrawniest kid on the playground, nobody is looking out for him or her.
sentences.zh: 如果你想象一下，比如朝鲜就像操场上那个最矮小、最瘦弱的孩子，没有人罩着他。

sentences.en: And he is picking fights with every other kid on the playground, including kids who are, like, ten times his height and could squash him like a bug if he wanted to.
sentences.zh: 而他却在和操场上的其他每一个孩子挑衅，包括那些身高是他十倍、只要愿意就能像捏死虫子一样捏死他的大块头。

sentences.en: So the way that he is going to deal with and manage that threat is by putting, like, a little bit of glass in the food of these bigger kids or, like,
sentences.zh: 所以他将要用来处理和应对这种威胁的方式，就是在这些大孩子的食物里加一点玻璃渣，或者，

sentences.en: is that a little too intense?
sentences.zh: 这会不会有点太激烈了？

sentences.en: It's like a terrifying elementary school.
sentences.zh: 就像一个可怕的小学。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, that's the idea is to act, like, so outside the norms of how kids manage in the elementary school that everybody is like, look,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，这就是他们的想法：其行事方式如此超乎小学里孩子们相处常规之外，以至于每个人都觉得，听着，

sentences.en: we don't like this little Kim Jong-un kid.
sentences.zh: 我们不喜欢这个叫金正恩的小屁孩。

sentences.en: We would really rather that he was not around.
sentences.zh: 我们其实更希望他不在。

sentences.en: We have the power to squash him, and we would kind of like to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们有能力捏死他，而且我们也挺想这么做。

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's not worth getting glass in our food.
sentences.zh: 为了他让我们的食物里吃到玻璃渣，可不值得。

sentences.en: So real quickly, let's step back for a minute.
sentences.zh: 所以长话短说，我们先退后一步想一想。

sentences.en: What is it about the history of North Korea that we have to understand in order to properly contextualize this moment and this assassination?
sentences.zh: 为了正确理解当下的局势和这场暗杀，我们必须了解朝鲜历史的哪些方面？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The thing that you need to understand to get why they do this is it's all about internal political legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 要想明白他们为什么这样做，你需要理解的一点是，这一切都关乎内部的政治合法性。

sentences.en: South Korea is much richer now and much freer and more prosperous.
sentences.zh: 现在的韩国要富裕得多，也更自由、更繁荣。

sentences.en: And, like, the North Korean government can't hide that information from its people.
sentences.zh: 而且，朝鲜政府无法向其人民隐瞒这些信息。

sentences.en: So how does it continue to have a reason to justify its own existence as this separate North Korean state?
sentences.zh: 那么，它如何才能继续拥有一个理由，来为自己作为这个独立的朝鲜国家的生存合理性进行辩护呢？

sentences.en: And the answer that Kim Jong-il, who was Kim Jong-un's father, landed on in the 90s is something that he called the Songun or Military First Policy,
sentences.zh: 金正恩的父亲金正日上世纪 90 年代得出的答案是，他称之为“先军”或“先军政治”的政策，

sentences.en: which is basically this big lie they tell the people,
sentences.zh: 这基本上是他们对人民撒的一个弥天大谎，

sentences.en: which is that they are under constant threat of war from the terrifying Yankee imperialists who are going to come any second to destroy them.
sentences.zh: 即他们正面临着来自可怕的洋基帝国主义者的持续战争威胁，这些敌人随时都会来消灭他们。

sentences.en: And so they have to fight this, like, never-ending battle.
sentences.zh: 因此他们必须进行这场没完没了的斗争。

sentences.en: And it really works.
sentences.zh: 这真的很管用。

sentences.en: It's really effective because you get this, like, rally around the flag, nationalism against the external enemy.
sentences.zh: 它非常有效，因为你可以借此号召民众团结在国旗下，激起针对外部敌人的民族主义。

sentences.en: And then you can justify to your own people, like, well, you're poor because we have to pay for this giant military to stave off the threat.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以向自己的人民解释：嗯，你们之所以穷，是因为我们必须花钱维持这支庞大的军队来抵御威胁。

sentences.en: And it has kept this regime impossibly stable for the last 25 years.
sentences.zh: 正是靠着这一点，这个政权在过去 25 年里保持了不可思议的稳定。

sentences.en: But the thing is, is that means they have to keep up the reality of this, like, near conflict, super high tensions.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这意味着他们必须维持这种濒临冲突、超级紧张局势的现实。

sentences.en: And that becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy because by creating that situation, they create more of an incentive for states like South Korea, Japan,
sentences.zh: 这就变成了一种自我实现的预言，因为通过制造这种局面，他们为韩国、日本等国提供了更多的动机，

sentences.en: and the United States to want to get rid of North Korea.
sentences.zh: 让他们更想除掉朝鲜。

sentences.en: And I think that that brings up something else, which is that after the Cold War ended, North Korea was extremely poor.
sentences.zh: 我想这也引发了另一件事，那就是冷战结束后，朝鲜极其贫困。

sentences.en: They experienced a catastrophic famine.
sentences.zh: 他们经历了一场灾难性的饥荒。

sentences.en: A really large percent of the country died.
sentences.zh: 全国有相当大比例的人口死亡。

sentences.en: I think some estimates it's 5% to 10%.
sentences.zh: 我想一些估计认为比例在 5% 到 10%。

sentences.en: Yeah, nobody knows for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，谁也说不准。

sentences.en: I mean, just huge.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，简直是灭顶之灾。

sentences.en: But that's, I mean, that's just an absolute catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，那简直是一场绝对的灾难。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that not only did the regime not collapse because of internal opposition,
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，该政权不仅没有因为内部反对而崩溃，

sentences.en: they also didn't open themselves politically to the rest of the world to engage in the kind of ties or get the kind of aid that could have saved these people.
sentences.zh: 他们也没有在政治上向世界其他地方开放，以建立那种能够拯救这些人的联系或获得那种援助。

sentences.en: And so they have shown themselves pretty credibly to be willing to sacrifice their own civilians.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们相当可信地向世人展示了他们甘愿牺牲自己的平民。

sentences.en: It's a strategic asset.
sentences.zh: 这是一种战略资产。

sentences.en: It's a really powerful strategic asset.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常强大的战略资产。

sentences.en: Their willingness to accept risk.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意承担风险的意愿。

sentences.en: Yeah, which is, you know, terribly dangerous if you are a North Korean citizen and quite dangerous if you are a citizen of another country, but a real asset to the regime there.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，如果你是朝鲜公民，这就极其危险；如果你是其他国家的公民，也相当危险，但这确实是当地政权的一大资产。

sentences.en: Max and Amanda, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马克斯和阿曼达，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Dana.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫达娜。

sentences.en: I am a subscriber to the New York Times, but my husband isn't.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的订户，但我丈夫不是。

sentences.en: And it would be really nice to be able to share a recipe or an article or compete with him in Wordle or Connections.
sentences.zh: 如果能跟他分享食谱或文章，或者在 Wordle 或 Connections 游戏中一较高下，那就太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dana, we heard you.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我们听到你们的心声了。

sentences.en: It's why we created the New York Times Family Subscription.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们推出《纽约时报》家庭订阅服务的原因。

sentences.en: One subscription up to four separate logins for anyone in your life.
sentences.zh: 一个订阅，为生活中任何人提供最多四个独立的登录账号。

sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 family 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: In his speech to Congress on Tuesday night, President Trump turned for a moment, and unexpectedly, from illegal immigration to another form.
sentences.zh: 在周二晚间对国会的演讲中，特朗普总统出人意料地话锋一转，从非法移民转向了另一种形式。

sentences.en: Protecting our workers also means reforming our system of legal immigration.
sentences.zh: 保护我们的工人也意味着改革我们的合法移民制度。

sentences.en: The current outdated system depresses wages for our poorest workers and puts great pressure on taxpayers.
sentences.zh: 当前过时的系统压低了我们最贫困工人的工资，并给纳税人带来了巨大的压力。

sentences.en: Nations around the world, like Canada, Australia, and many others, have a merit-based immigration system.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的国家，比如加拿大、澳大利亚以及许多其他国家，都拥有择优录取的移民制度。

sentences.en: Merit-based.
sentences.zh: 择优录取。

sentences.en: It sounds distinctly American, but it's not at all what drives American immigration.
sentences.zh: 听起来极具美国特色，但这根本不是驱动美国移民政策的动力。

sentences.en: Well, a merit-based immigration system is one that essentially prioritizes skills and employability over everything else.
sentences.zh: 嗯，择优录取的移民制度基本上是一个把技能和就业能力置于一切之上的系统。

sentences.en: Julie Davis is a White House reporter.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯是白宫记者。

sentences.en: So we're talking about educational level, if you have an advanced degree, and potentially whether you have an employer sponsoring you.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论的是教育水平，你是否拥有高等学位，以及潜在的是否有雇主为你提供担保。

sentences.en: And sometimes the way it works is that all of those things I just mentioned are given sort of a point rating.
sentences.zh: 有时它的运作方式是，我刚才提到的所有这些因素都会被赋予某种积分评级。

sentences.en: And the people who have the highest amount of points are the people who are at the top of the priority liSt.
sentences.zh: 积分最高的人就是排在优先名单顶端的人。

sentences.en: Obviously, every country that has net immigration has a long waiting list of people who want to get in.
sentences.zh: 显然，每一个有净移民流入的国家都有一长串想要进入该国的等待名单。

sentences.en: So a merit-based system essentially evaluates those people based on those criteria.
sentences.zh: 因此，择优系统基本上是根据这些标准对这些人进行评估。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So how does that merit-based system that assigns those points to skills and education differ from the immigration system in place now in the United States?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个根据技能和教育赋予积分的择优系统，与美国目前现行的移民系统有何不同？

sentences.en: Well, the immigration system that's been in place in the United States essentially since 1965 is predominantly based on family ties.
sentences.zh: 嗯，美国自 1965 年以来基本一直在实行的移民系统，主要基于家庭纽带。

sentences.en: The vast majority of people that are admitted here under the legal immigration system are admitted on the basis of being related to a U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据合法移民系统被接纳到这里的绝大多数人，都是以与美国公民有亲属关系并由其担保，

sentences.en: citizen and sponsored by them or a more distant relative of somebody who is already here legally.
sentences.zh: 或者是与已经在美合法居留的人有更远亲属关系为基础被接纳的。

sentences.en: So the argument for a family-based immigration system seems very straightforward.
sentences.zh: 因此，基于家庭的移民系统的理由似乎非常直接明了。

sentences.en: So what's the argument against it?
sentences.zh: 那么反对的理由是什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, the argument against it is, I think, the one that President Trump was trying to make in his speech, which is...
sentences.zh: 嗯，反对的理由，我认为就是特朗普总统在演讲中试图表达的那样，也就是……

sentences.en: It's a basic principle that those seeking to enter a country ought to be able to support themselves financially.
sentences.zh: 这是一个基本原则，即那些寻求进入一个国家的人应该能够在经济上养活自己。

sentences.en: We are a country that should want for our immigrants to make this country better.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个应该希望移民让这个国家变得更好的国家。

sentences.en: We should want Americans to have good jobs and good wages.
sentences.zh: 我们应该希望美国人拥有好的工作和好的工资。

sentences.en: And we should put Americans firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们应该把美国人放在首位。

sentences.en: It will save countless dollars, raise workers' wages, and help struggling families, including immigrant families, enter the middle class.
sentences.zh: 这将节省无数美元，提高工人的工资，并帮助包括移民家庭在内的苦苦挣扎的家庭跨入中产阶级。

sentences.en: And they will do it quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会很快做到。

sentences.en: And they will be very, very happy indeed.
sentences.zh: 而且他们确实会非常非常高兴。

sentences.en: And so it's been the case for a long time that employers in the United States feel like they don't have access to the labor pool that they need.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，美国的雇主们一直觉得他们无法获得他们所需的劳动力。

sentences.en: And so I think there's broad support, theoretically, for rejiggering the system such that there are more immigrants coming in that fill gaps in the employment pool.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，在理论上，人们广泛支持重新调整系统，以便让更多的移民进来填补就业市场的空白。

sentences.en: And I think that in and of itself is not a controversial idea.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这本身并不是一个具争议性的想法。

sentences.en: I think where the controversy comes in is when you start looking at the numbers and the people that you'd be denying the chance to stay with their families if you, in effect,
sentences.zh: 我认为争议出现的地方在于，当你开始审视数字以及那些如果实际上被剥夺了机会、

sentences.en: took away some of these preferences and gave them over to employers and skilled labor.
sentences.zh: 取消其中一些优先权并将其交由雇主和熟练劳动力，就无法与家人团聚的人时。

sentences.en: Well, so let's talk about those numbers.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我们来谈谈这些数字。

sentences.en: Right now, what percentage of immigrants entering the U.S.
sentences.zh: 目前，进入美国的移民中，有百分之多少

sentences.en: are the family, the relatives of people who are already here?
sentences.zh: 是已经在这里的人的家属和亲戚？

sentences.en: So it's about two-thirds of the people that are admitted legally into the United States as immigrants are either immediate relatives or more distant relatives of U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，合法进入美国作为移民的人中，大约有三分之二不是美国公民

sentences.en: citizens or legal permanent residents.
sentences.zh: 或合法永久居民的直系亲属，就是更远一点的亲属。

sentences.en: With all this conversation about immigration from him so far being so polarizing and pretty far to the right,
sentences.zh: 鉴于他迄今为止关于移民的所有言论都如此具有两极分化且相当偏右，

sentences.en: I was so struck by the fact that in selling this idea in his speech to Congress,
sentences.zh: 我感到非常震惊的是，特朗普在向国会的演讲中推销这个想法时，

sentences.en: Trump pointed to Canada as an example of where this merit-based system is in place because Canada is seen as really progressive, especially on immigration,
sentences.zh: 把加拿大作为一个实行这种择优系统的例子，因为在许多美国人看来，加拿大被视为非常进步，特别是在移民问题上，

sentences.en: at least to many Americans.
sentences.zh: 至少对许多美国人来说是这样。

sentences.en: Well, in Canada, it's a system that's been in place for almost as long as our family-based system has been in place.
sentences.zh: 在加拿大，这个系统实行的时间几乎和我们的家庭团聚系统一样长。

sentences.en: And it's a country that's, you know, one-tenth the size of the United States, and they admit more immigrants, I think it's about 160,000 a year,
sentences.zh: 而且这个国家，你知道，规模只有美国十分之一，他们每年接纳的移民，我想大概是16万左右，

sentences.en: than the United States does under economic categories.
sentences.zh: 比美国在经济类别下接纳的要多。

sentences.en: So that's a fairly substantial difference.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当大的差异。

sentences.en: And the other thing that we saw in Canada last year as the Syrian refugee crisis was raging was that they also have a lot of refugees that they admit.
sentences.zh: 我们在去年叙利亚难民危机肆虐时在加拿大看到的另一件事是，他们也接纳了大量的难民。

sentences.en: But I think what we see is a much broader sort of degree of public support than we have here, where because it's so politically volatile,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们看到的是比这里更广泛的公众支持度，在这里，由于政治上如此多变，

sentences.en: it's difficult to get consensus to change any one piece of it.
sentences.zh: 很难就改变其中的任何一部分达成共识。

sentences.en: So let's pretend that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们假设美国

sentences.en: under President Trump adopts this merit-based system of immigration.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统的领导下采用了这种择优移民系统。

sentences.en: What nationalities of immigrants would we likely start to see more of and would we start to see less of?
sentences.zh: 我们可能会开始看到更多什么国籍的移民，又会开始看到更少什么国籍的移民？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, many of the immigrants who are here legally now and who have been here for a long time are either Mexican or Latin American immigrants,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，许多现在合法在这里并且已经在这里很长时间的移民，要么是墨西哥或拉丁美洲移民，

sentences.en: and many of them are Asian as well.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人也是亚洲人。

sentences.en: They've been steadily over the years bringing family members in,
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们一直在源源不断地把家人接过来，

sentences.en: and if you were to all of a sudden tomorrow flip the switch so that you were limiting or eliminating altogether their ability to bring in family members,
sentences.zh: 如果你明天突然一翻开关，限制或完全取消他们把家人接过来的能力，

sentences.en: you'd be talking about less immigrants in general of color.
sentences.zh: 你所说的总体上有色人种移民就会减少。

sentences.en: And if you're talking about high-skilled labor,
sentences.zh: 如果你谈论的是高技能劳动力，

sentences.en: if you're talking about people who know how to speak English or have been educated in the Western sciences that many employers will prioritize,
sentences.zh: 如果你谈论的是那些懂得说英语或接受过许多雇主会优先考虑的西方科学教育的人，

sentences.en: you are probably looking at a whiter, more Western European group of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 你可能看到的是一群更白、更偏西欧的移民。

sentences.en: Does support or does opposition to this idea of merit-based versus family-based immigration, does it neatly fall along party lines?
sentences.zh: 这种对择优系统与家庭团聚系统之争的支持或反对，是否完全沿着党派界线划分？

sentences.en: Do Republicans tend to support the merit-based system and the Democrats tend to support the family, or is it messier?
sentences.zh: 共和党人倾向于支持择优系统，而民主党人倾向于支持家庭系统，还是情况更复杂？

sentences.en: It's a little messier, but I would say in general, this is a Republican idea.
sentences.zh: 情况要复杂一些，但我要说的是，总的来说，这是一个共和党的主张。

sentences.en: The last time this was a major component of an immigration overhaul, 10 years ago when George W.
sentences.zh: 上一次这成为移民全面改革的重要组成部分，还是10年前乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush was president, it was a get-tough border security bill that essentially legalized the 11 million undocumented immigrants who were here.
sentences.zh: 布什担任总统时，那是一项严厉打击边境安全的法案，基本上使这里1100万无证移民合法化了。

sentences.en: And moved toward, in a pretty dramatic way, a high-skilled immigration system.
sentences.zh: 并朝着建立高技能移民系统的方向迈出了相当大的一步。

sentences.en: And that was an idea that was a Republican idea that Democrats were willing to consider only because they were getting a large-scale legalization in return.
sentences.zh: 这是一个共和党的主张，民主党人之所以愿意考虑，只是因为他们作为回报得到了大规模的合法化。

sentences.en: But that plan ultimately fizzled.
sentences.zh: 但那个计划最终不了了之。

sentences.en: Cratered, more like, yes.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说是彻底砸了，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's politically, it's always been politically difficult, bordering on toxic.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，从政治上讲，它一直都很棘手，几近有毒。

sentences.en: I don't think there's any reason to believe that that has changed.
sentences.zh: 我认为没有任何理由相信这一点已经改变。

sentences.en: And certainly when you have a president like President Trump, who has spoken in such incendiary terms about immigration,
sentences.zh: 当然，当你有一位像特朗普总统这样用如此煽动性言辞谈论移民的总统时，

sentences.en: it's difficult to imagine Democrats and the left wanting to make hard choices to come to the middle and meet him when there's so much suspicion about what his real motives and where his real priorities lay.
sentences.zh: 很难想象民主党人和左翼会愿意做出艰难的抉择来走到中间去迎合他，因为对于他的真正动机和真正优先事项存在着如此多的怀疑。

sentences.en: I'm really struck by this thought that there are pretty much two narratives in the United States when it comes to immigration.
sentences.zh: 我真的对这样一个想法深感触动：在美国，关于移民基本上存在着两种叙事。

sentences.en: One of them is that this is a place where anything is possible.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，这是一个一切皆有可能的地方。

sentences.en: You come here in pursuit of the American dream.
sentences.zh: 你来到这里是为了追求美国梦。

sentences.en: It does not matter how much money or skill you have at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 一开始你有多少钱或技能并不重要。

sentences.en: And the other narrative is that this is a meritocracy and that the best rise and that success is earned and it's rewarded.
sentences.zh: 另一种叙事是，这是一个精英统治的地方，最好的人会脱颖而出，成功是靠挣来的，也是有回报的。

sentences.en: And this system that the president is now talking about seems to pit these two narratives against each other.
sentences.zh: 而总统现在所谈论的这个系统似乎让这两种叙事互相对立起来。

sentences.en: Is that how you see it?
sentences.zh: 你是这么看的吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think it's fascinating because I think the answer is really both.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这很迷人，因为我认为答案实际上是两者兼有。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, when you hear the argument that President Trump is making,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你听到特朗普总统的论点时，

sentences.en: it's hard to disagree with the idea that we should want people to come here who are great and who share our priorities and share our values.
sentences.zh: 你很难不同意这种观点：我们应该希望那些优秀、分享我们的优先事项和价值观的人来到这里。

sentences.en: But when you look at the flip side of that, I think you see some uglier implications, like we shouldn't have people here who don't believe in the same things that we believe in,
sentences.zh: 但当你看到它的另一面时，我认为你会看到一些更丑陋的含义，比如我们不应该让那些不信仰我们所信仰事物的人呆在这里，

sentences.en: whether that's religion or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 不管是宗教还是其他方面。

sentences.en: But yes, the United States is a meritocracy.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，美国是一个精英统治的国家。

sentences.en: And I don't think that anyone would argue that our immigration system should downplay that to the degree it looks like it does on paper.
sentences.zh: 我不认为会有人争辩说，我们的移民系统应该在纸面上看起来的程度上淡化这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's a tension.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种张力。

sentences.en: And I think it's the reason why immigration reform has always been such an emotional issue in this country and a politically difficult one.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是为什么移民改革在这个国家一直是一个如此充满情感且在政治上棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And I think if we get anywhere close to it under President Trump, that tension is only going to get sharper.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果我们能在特朗普总统任内接近解决这个问题，这种张力只会变得更加尖锐。

sentences.en: All right, Julie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好了，朱莉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that in the final hours of the Obama presidency, White House aides raced to preserve evidence that Russia had tried to undermine the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，在奥巴马总统任期的最后几个小时里，白宫助手们竞相保存俄罗斯曾试图破坏美国

sentences.en: election.
sentences.zh: 大选的证据。

sentences.en: Presidential staff were so worried that the incoming Trump administration would cover up or destroy intelligence about the meddling that they tried to ensure that the information was distributed to as many sources as possible,
sentences.zh: 总统幕僚非常担心即将上台的特朗普政府会掩盖或销毁关于干预的谍报信息，以至于他们竭力确保这些信息被分发给尽可能多的来源，

sentences.en: including foreign allies and members of Congress and an update on a story from earlier this week about Juan Carlos Hernandez Pacheco,
sentences.zh: 包括外国盟友和国会议员；以及关于本周早些时候一则报道的最新进展，主角是胡安·卡洛斯·埃尔南德斯·帕切科，
zh_words: 胡安·卡洛斯·埃尔南德斯·帕切科

sentences.en: a restaurant owner in a small southern Illinois town who was detained by federal immigration officials on February 9th after living in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他是伊利诺伊州南部一个小镇的一名餐馆老板，在无证在美国生活了20年后，于2月9日被联邦移民官员扣留。

sentences.en: for 20 years without documentation.
sentences.zh: 这个压倒性投票支持唐纳德·特朗普的小镇，公开站出来支持卡洛斯。

sentences.en: The town, which voted overwhelmingly for Donald Trump, has come out in support of Carlos.
sentences.zh: 镇长、消防长、县检察官以及当地企业主蒂姆·格里格斯比等人代表卡洛斯给法官写了信。

sentences.en: The mayor, the fire chief, the county prosecutor, and local business owners like Tim Grigsby wrote letters to the judge on Carlos's behalf.
sentences.zh: 我们的社区将会出现一个很难填补的漏洞，如果我们还能填补的话。

sentences.en: Our community is going to have a hole in it that will be very difficult to fill if we'll ever be able to fill it.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事莫妮卡·戴维从一开始就在报道这个故事，她周三下午出席了卡洛斯的移民听证会。

sentences.en: Our colleague Monica Davey, who has been reporting on this story from the start, was at Carlos's immigration hearing on Wednesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯今天下午出庭了，他正启程回法兰克福西区。

sentences.en: Carlos was on this afternoon, and he's headed home to West Frankfurt.
sentences.zh: 案中的法官有没有说明他允许卡洛斯保释的原因？

sentences.en: Did the judge in the case give a reason for why he allowed Carlos to become free on bond?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他做的一件事是谈到了他收到的一些信件。

sentences.en: Well, one thing he did was he talked about some of the letters he has received.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他说你就是不能……

sentences.en: Basically, he said you just don't...
sentences.zh: 你有没有机会在卡洛斯出来后跟他谈谈？

sentences.en: Did you have a chance to talk to Carlos once he was out?
sentences.zh: 如果你谈了，他说什么了？

sentences.en: And if you did, what did he say?
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他相当坦诚。

sentences.en: He told me that he was pretty upfront.
sentences.zh: 对于自己能得到一些支持，他并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: He wasn't surprised to know that he had some support.
sentences.zh: 但我想他对于自己曾经对唐纳德·特朗普的看法以及现在这些人站出来说支持他感到相当震撼。

sentences.en: But I think he's been pretty bowled over by how he felt about Donald Trump and now coming forward and saying they support him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他有没有怪他们？

sentences.en: You know, did he blame them?
sentences.zh: 他有没有因为他们投了那样的票而生他们的气？

sentences.en: Did he feel angry at them for having voted that way?
sentences.zh: 他又说了什么？

sentences.en: And what did he say?
sentences.zh: 他说他一点那种感觉都没有。

sentences.en: He said he didn't feel that way at all.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他投票时没有针对移民问题，因为这只是跟采煤没关系的事情。

sentences.en: He felt like he hadn't voted on the issue of immigration because it's just not that going on coal mining.
sentences.zh: 他说他当时……
